description: What a day costs in a city at budget, mid-range and luxury, broken down into accommodation, food, transport and activities, with the editorial overview for each tier. Figures come from a hand-written catalogue of 100 cities. If the city is not in the catalogue this returns an error — it never estimates.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "lisbon" or "Lisbon".

title: Daily cost by budget tier
